description: Find Brazilian investment funds by words of their name, accents optional (e.g. 'previ acoes', 'verde'), or by their 14-digit register number, largest net assets first: each fund's name, manager, asset class, newest reported month, net assets in reais and slug. Pass the slug to GetBrazilianFundPortfolio for the fund's share portfolio. For US registered funds use SearchFunds; for the Brazilian funds holding one B3 share use GetBrazilianFundHoldings.

maxResults.description: Maximum funds, largest net assets first (default 20, max 50).

query.description: Words of the fund's name (all must appear, accents optional), or its register number with or without punctuation.

name: SearchBrazilianFunds
title: Search Brazilian Funds
